Meet Foxy

Professional nail care for ladies & gentlemen

Foxy Nails

Foxy Nails is a nail salon at Gateway Square on Gateway Drive in Mechanicsburg, PA, run by licensed technicians. The menu runs from a classic manicure to full acrylic and gel extensions, dip powder, French manicures and nail art, plus pedicures and waxing.

Men are on the menu too, with manicures and pedicures of their own. Come as a walk-in, or call ahead and skip the wait.

Walk-ins welcome
